q: Serco provides logistics sustainment and contingency support to IFRCO both OCONUS (Kuwait, Qatar, Iraq, djibouti, Jordan, & South Korea) by conducting logistics database administration and lifecycle management of supplies.

d: Purpose of the Service Engineer Role

The Service Engineer is a professional engineering and technical-support role responsible for advanced diagnosis, technical escalation, root-cause analysis, reliability improvement, OEM technical coordination, commissioning and engineering support for SANY heavy equipment in the UAE. The role is not simply a senior technician position. The Service Engineer provides the technical link between customers, field service technicians, Service Management and SANY/OEM
Lead complex diagnosis of hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, electronic, engine, transmission and machine-control failures.
Develop structured diagnostic strategies using machine history, fault codes, live data, measurements, schematics and OEM technical information.
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major, repeated and premature equipment failures.
Identify whether failures are related to component condition, contamination, installation, application, operation, maintenance, environment or design.
Recommend corrective and preventive actions and follow up their effectiveness.
Monitor recurring technical issues across SANY equipment fleets and identify reliability trends.
Provide technical escalation support to Service Technicians during difficult or unresolved breakdowns.
Review proposed major component replacements and repair methods for technically complex jobs.
Prepare technical failure reports containing symptoms, test results, findings, root cause, corrective action and recommendations.
Support warranty investigations and provide technically justified warranty recommendations.
Liaise with SANY factory/OEM technical support teams for unresolved technical issues.
Interpret and implement SANY service bulletins, technical campaigns, engineering updates and product modifications.
Plan and technically lead commissioning, PDI, functional testing and customer acceptance activities.
Support key customers and major project fleets with technical inspections, machine-health assessments and uptime improvement recommendations.
Develop technician capability through technical coaching, troubleshooting guidance and identification of training requirements.
Advanced hydraulic system diagnosis, including pressure/flow testing and interpretation of hydraulic circuit behavior.
Advanced electrical and electronic troubleshooting, including wiring diagrams, sensors, actuators, controllers and CAN-bus systems.
Strong knowledge of diesel engines, fuel, air, cooling, lubrication, exhaust/after-treatment and engine-management systems.
Powertrain knowledge covering transmissions, axles, final drives, swing systems and related control systems.
Ability to use OEM diagnostic software, electronic service tools and machine monitoring systems.
Ability to interpret technical manuals, hydraulic schematics, electrical drawings, specifications, service bulletins and component documentation.
Strong Root Cause Analysis and failure-analysis capability.
Ability to use measured technical evidence to validate diagnosis and repair recommendations.
Understanding of equipment reliability, preventive maintenance and condition-monitoring principles.
Strong technical report writing and engineering documentation skills.
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Mechatronics, Automobile/Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Heavy Equipment Engineering or a closely related discipline.
Diploma holders with substantial heavy-equipment engineering/service experience may be considered for selected positions.
SANY/OEM technical certification or manufacturer training is strongly preferred.
Training in hydraulics, diesel engines, electrical diagnostics, CAN-bus, condition monitoring, RCA or reliability engineering is an advantage.
Service Engineer: typically, 5–8+ years of relevant heavy-equipment service/engineering experience.
Senior Service Engineer: typically, 8–12+ years with proven technical leadership and advanced troubleshooting capability.
Experience with SANY equipment is highly preferred; experience with other leading heavy-equipment OEMs may be considered based on transferable technical competence.
UAE/GCC experience in construction, infrastructure, quarry, mining, ports, concrete, road machinery, logistics or industrial environments is highly desirable.
Proven experience with complex breakdowns, RCA, warranty investigations, technical escalation and commissioning is strongly preferred.
Serve as a credible technical representative of SANY UAE when dealing with major customers and project teams.
Translate technical findings into practical recommendations, risks, repair options and maintenance actions.
Lead technical discussions during critical machine-down situations.
Coordinate with Service, Parts, Warranty and Operations teams to reduce customer downtime.
Maintain ownership of technical issues until a verified corrective action is implemented.
